description: The pie chart illustrates the composition of the Darija Open Dataset Version 2, broken down into six distinct categories represented by colored segments with corresponding numerical values. The largest segment, colored yellow, represents “Extra + Augmented Data” with 45,387 entries. The second largest, in green, corresponds to “Pending Translations” with 43,000 entries. The blue segment indicates “Translated Sentences” totaling 30,000. The orange segment, labeled “Syntactic Roles (e.g., Verbs)”, accounts for 23,108 entries. Two very small segments are also present: a dark purple slice for “Semantic Categories” and a red slice for “Pending Translations” (though this label appears to be duplicated or misassigned in the legend, as the green segment already represents pending translations). The chart uses a 3D donut-style visualization with a central hole, and each segment is labeled with its exact count rather than percentage. The legend on the right matches colors to categories, though some labels are partially cut off or ambiguous, particularly for the smallest segments. The overall distribution suggests that augmented and pending data constitute the bulk of the dataset, while syntactic and semantic annotations make up smaller, more specialized portions.
